audit.whatIsWrong: The page treats Nevermove as a root that lands on the cast, and never mentions the pull.
audit.why: Riot text: 'Swain launches a wave of demonic power forward. It then returns to Swain and roots enemies it hits. Swain can then choose to pull all rooted champions closer.' The root is applied on the RETURN pass, so a Fiora holding Riposte for the outgoing wave parries nothing and eats the root a second later. It is also the return you want to parry to earn the stun. Death's Hand drops to a 3s cooldown at rank 5, so waiting out his poke is not a plan.
audit.corrected: Nevermove roots on the return pass, not the throw — parry the wave coming back, and expect the pull if you are rooted.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal is mentioned only in the itemization block, not where the trade decision happens.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags both 'needs-antiheal' and 'resistances-invalidated' on Ravenous Flock: his souls heal him and permanently raise his max health, which also means stacking MR alone does not fix the extended fight — cutting the healing does.
audit.corrected: Ravenous Flock heals him off every soul — bring Grievous Wounds before you commit.
